source_en: You read the last page first. Ia Lomidze, archive librarian.
Fewer readers every day. They all ask what happens next.
Endings are written long before anyone reads them. I tell them that.
Every morning. The smog gets in the pages. I open it anyway.
I've already read past this part. I don't say that to frighten you.
To you? I wouldn't say. Some things are better as a surprise.
Everything odd feels ordinary when the plot requires it.
Go on. Stamp it. You already have.
